summary: ansible-navigator :open uses vi +{line_number} {filename} or $EDITOR by default; set editor.command and editor.console for emacs, VS Code (code -g {filename}:{line_number}) or PyCharm. Settings apply in order: defaults, settings file, environment variables, command line, then : commands in the TUI. Troubleshoot with --log-level debug.
questions: Why does vi open when I use :open in ansible-navigator?
How do I make ansible-navigator open VS Code?
In what order does ansible-navigator apply settings?
How do I enable debug logging in ansible-navigator?

answer_card.title: ansible-navigator editor and settings precedence
answer_card.answer_md:
**Editor for `:open`** (default `vi +{line_number} {filename}` or `$EDITOR`):

```yaml
ansible-navigator:
  editor:
    command: code -g {filename}:{line_number}
    console: false
```

**Settings precedence** (last wins): defaults, settings file, environment variables, command-line flags, `:` commands in the TUI.

**Troubleshooting:** run with `--log-level debug` and check the log file.
